provenance: Authored 2026-08-02 for the Stage-C classifier corpus (assistant-authored; creator ratifies with the corpus). Subject: Task Tracker API @ demo/dotnet d27600f. A wrong map is the classifier's largest deterministic failure mode (design doc §12); ADV-03 tests the adjudication net behind it.

surfaceClasses.auth: credentials, keys, auth enforcement (C-13 surface class)
surfaceClasses.contract-dependency: public API surface, schemas, dependency manifests
surfaceClasses.process: decision-density and other process signals (M4); M5 carries NO surface and never counts toward the C-13 full-set rule

pii.note: Deliberately empty for the demo subject — no PII paths exist; corpus observation O-5.

api-surface-source.note: M3 fires on route-marker DELTA in the patch (added/removed route registrations), never on bare path-touch — otherwise every endpoint edit (SC-06) would owe a delta spec.

dependency-manifests.note: New direct package or major bump -> M3 (materiality, C-4); patch/minor bump -> X3 (mechanical).

renameShapeGuard.note: C-14: a rename-shaped diff demotes M2 class-path hits to adjudication candidates.

x1Thresholds.note: Provisional (design doc §12: calibrated by corpus + step-5, not argued a priori).
